name: Incline Chest Press (Plate Loaded)
setup_cues: Adjust seat so handles line up with upper chest;Load plates on both sides evenly

name: Decline Chest Press (Plate Loaded)
setup_cues: Seat yourself so handles line up with lower chest;Load plates on both sides evenly

name: Vertical Chest Press
setup_cues: Adjust seat so handles are at mid-chest;Back flat against the pad

name: Pec Fly / Rear Delt Machine
setup_cues: Set handle position for front (fly) or rear (reverse fly) use;Adjust seat so arms are level with shoulders

name: Lat Pulldown
setup_cues: Set thigh pad snug over thighs;Reach up and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders

name: Seated Cable Row
setup_cues: Chest against the pad, feet on the plate;Start with arms fully extended and shoulders relaxed

name: Assisted Pull-Up / Dip Machine
setup_cues: Pin sets the assistance: more weight on the stack means easier;Kneel on the pad for pull-ups or dips

name: Standing Multi Flight
setup_cues: Function to be confirmed by owner

name: Cable Crossover
setup_cues: Set both pulleys to the same height;Stand centred between the stacks with a staggered stance

name: Olympic Incline Bench
setup_cues: Eyes under the bar, feet flat on the floor;Use a spotter or safety catches for heavy sets

name: Olympic Flat Bench
setup_cues: Eyes under the bar, shoulder blades pinched together;Feet flat, use a spotter for heavy sets

name: Preacher Curl Bench
setup_cues: Armpits snug on top of the pad;Seat height so upper arms rest fully on the pad

name: Shoulder Press Machine (Plate Loaded)
setup_cues: Seat height so handles start at shoulder level;Back flat against the pad

name: Biceps Curl Machine
setup_cues: Adjust seat so elbows line up with the machine pivot;Upper arms flat on the pad

name: Front Lat Pulldown (Plate Loaded)
setup_cues: Adjust seat and chest pad so arms hang fully stretched at the start;Load plates evenly

name: Seated Calf Raise
setup_cues: Balls of feet on the platform, knee pad snug on lower thighs;Release the safety, then lower heels fully

name: Prone Leg Curl
setup_cues: Roller sits just above the heels;Hips stay pressed into the pad

name: Hip Adductor / Abductor
setup_cues: Set the start position pads for a comfortable stretch;Sit tall with back against the pad

name: 45 Degree Leg Press
setup_cues: Feet shoulder-width on the platform, lower back stays on the pad;Release the safety handles before pressing

name: Hip Thrust Machine
setup_cues: Upper back on the pad, belt or pad across the hips;Feet flat, shins vertical at the top

name: Hack Squat
setup_cues: Back and shoulders flat on the pad;Feet shoulder-width, lower under control

name: Leg Extension
setup_cues: Knees line up with the machine pivot;Pad sits on the lower shin just above the ankles

name: Smith Machine
setup_cues: Set safety stops at the right height before starting;Twist the bar to unrack and twist back to rack

name: Back Extension
setup_cues: Pad sits just below the hip bones so you can hinge freely;Keep a straight line from head to heels at the top

name: Adjustable Bench
setup_cues: Lock the backrest pin firmly at the chosen angle;Feet flat on the floor

name: Flat Incline Combo Bench
setup_cues: Check the seat/back adjustment pins are locked;Use a spotter or safety catches for heavy sets

name: Utility Bench
setup_cues: Back fully supported against the pad;Feet flat on the floor

name: Flat Bench
setup_cues: Check the bench is stable before loading;Keep feet planted and core braced

name: Dumbbells and Rack
setup_cues: Pick up and re-rack dumbbells with a flat back;Start light to learn the movement

name: Cable Attachments
setup_cues: V tricep handle, curved lat bar, straight bars, EZ curl bar, strap handles, square and D handles, MAG rowing handles (small/medium/large) are available;Clip the attachment securely before every set

name: Olympic Barbell
setup_cues: Load plates evenly and fit collars;Use the power cage safety arms for squats and presses

name: Olympic EZ Bar
setup_cues: Grip on the angled sections;Load plates evenly and fit collars

name: Power Cage
setup_cues: Set the bar hooks just below shoulder height;Set the safety arms just below your lowest squat depth

name: Lifting Platform
setup_cues: Bar over mid-foot, shins close to the bar;Brace before pulling

name: Treadmill
setup_cues: Clip the safety key to your clothing;Start at a slow speed and build up

name: Curve Treadmill
setup_cues: Self-powered belt: you set the pace with your stride;Hold the handles on first use

name: Elliptical Cross Trainer
setup_cues: Hold the moving handles for an upper-body workout;Keep your weight through the whole foot

name: Rowing Machine
setup_cues: Strap feet in snug across the balls of the feet;Drive with legs first, then lean back, then pull

name: Ski Erg
setup_cues: Stand tall with a slight forward lean;Pull the handles down with arms and a hip hinge

name: Spin Bike
setup_cues: Saddle height at hip level when standing next to the bike;Tighten the shoe cages or clips

name: Upright Bike
setup_cues: Set saddle so knee is slightly bent at the bottom of the stroke;Sit tall

name: Recumbent Bike
setup_cues: Adjust the seat so your legs are almost straight at full pedal extension;Back supported against the seat

name: Battle Rope
setup_cues: Anchor the rope at its middle;Stand in a quarter squat with a braced core

name: Kettlebells
setup_cues: Hold the handle with both hands for swings;Keep a flat back

name: Medicine Ball
setup_cues: Pick a ball weight you can control;Keep your core braced

name: Wall Ball
setup_cues: Stand about an arm's length from a solid wall;Catch the ball and go straight into the next squat

name: Stability Ball
setup_cues: Pick a ball size where your knees are level with your hips when seated;Keep the ball on a non-slip floor

name: Half Stability Ball
setup_cues: Place on a flat, non-slip surface;Step on or hold the edges with control

name: Resistance Tubes
setup_cues: Check the tube for cracks before each use;Hold the handles and keep tension through the full movement

name: Suspension Trainer
setup_cues: Anchor strap to a secure high point and test it first;Adjust strap length before each exercise

name: Foam Roller
setup_cues: Roll slowly over the muscle and pause on tender spots;Do not roll directly over joints

name: Jump Rope
setup_cues: Rope should reach your armpits when you stand on the middle;Jump low, land softly on the balls of the feet

name: Ab Wheel
setup_cues: Kneel on a mat;Keep your hips from sagging

name: Yoga Mat
setup_cues: Use for floor exercises;Keep the mat on a non-slip floor

name: Soft Plyo Box
setup_cues: Place the box on a flat, non-slip floor;Land softly with whole foot on the box
